blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Panoptic scene graph generation (PSGG) represents scene entities with segmentation masks and directed relations. Equirectangular projection (ERP) panoramas challenge PSGG through distortion, latitude-dependent pixel areas, and an artificial seam. We propose a two-stage spherical geometry-aware framework that fuses overlapping perspective-view predictions using observation reliability, spherical overlap, and angular proximity. Relation reasoning combines spherical-area-aware aggregation, weighted no-relation supervision, and dual-longitude score fusion. We also construct a dataset of 340 high-resolution panoramas with 10,571 nodes and 6,632 directed relations. Against corresponding baselines, spherical fusion improves PQ by 36.03% under matched views, while relation reasoning improves mR@50 by 11.20% under PredCls with ground-truth masks and object labels. The full framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% under SGDet with predicted panoptic segments. These results demonstrate the value of spherical geometry for panoramic PSGG.
blocks.zh: 泛视场景图生成(PSGG)代表场景实体,带有分区口罩和定向关系. equictangular project(ERP)全景通过扭曲,依赖纬度的像素区域,以及人工缝合来挑战PSGG. 我们提出一个两阶段的球形几何认识框架,利用观测可靠性,球形重叠,角近等方法,将重叠的视角-视角预测引信. 关系推理结合了球面-区域-意识聚合,加权无关系监督,双经分数聚变. 我们还建造了一个340个高分辨率全景数据集,有10 571个节点和6 632个定向关系。 根据相应的基线,球状聚变在匹配视图下将PQ提高36.03%,而关系推理在PredCls下将mR@50提高11.20%,并带有地面真伪口罩和物体标签. 整个框架在SGDet下将mR@50改进了52.99%,并预设了泛光片段。 这些结果显示球形几何对全景PSGG的价值.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Panoptic scene graph generation (PSGG) represents scene entities with
segmentation masks and directed semantic relations [ 11 ] .
Panoramas capture full-scene entities and interactions in one observation.
Prior work exploits panoramic context for holistic 3D
understanding [ 14 , 1 ] and studies
omni-range context [ 12 ] , projection
distortion [ 15 , 16 ] , and spherical
geometry [ 5 , 4 ] in panoramic segmentation. PSGG models address
predicate imbalance [ 17 ] , pair selection [ 9 ] ,
and mask-aware relation modeling and ranking through
DSFormer [ 7 ] , but largely assume perspective images.
Panoramic PSGG must therefore model spherical geometry in both entity
representation and relation prediction.

blocks.en:
Equirectangular projection creates three geometric challenges for
panoramic PSGG (Fig. 1 ): distorted object
boundaries , unequal spherical areas for equal-sized image regions ,
and seam-separated relational context . Overlapping perspective views
reduce distortion but yield duplicate or truncated instances with inconsistent
identities, requiring reliable association and fusion. Relation features should
reflect spherical rather than image area, and relation-existence predictions
should remain stable when the longitude origin moves the ERP seam without
changing the scene.

blocks.en:
We make three contributions. (1) Spherical geometry-aware panoptic
segmentation (SGPS) associates and fuses cross-view instances using
observation reliability, spherical overlap, and angular proximity, improving
PQ by 36.03% over a baseline with the same view configuration.
(2) Spherical geometry-aware relation reasoning (SGRR) combines
spherical-area-aware aggregation, weighted no-relation supervision, and
dual-longitude score fusion. Under PredCls, this module improves mR@50 by
11.20% over its corresponding baseline. (3) A high-resolution
panoramic PSGG dataset comprises 340 panoramas, 10,571 nodes, and 6,632
directed relations with multi-stage quality control. Under SGDet, the complete
framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% over the corresponding baseline, while
stage-wise ablation isolates the gains from SGPS and SGRR.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: 3.1 PanoPSG Dataset and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 帕诺普SG 数据集和实验设置

blocks.en:
We introduce PanoPSG, a high-resolution panoramic panoptic scene graph
dataset comprising 340 ERP panoramas, each with full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} coverage
and a resolution of 11968 × 5984 11968\times 5984 pixels (Table 1 ).
Reviewer-verified masks were delineated in CVAT, while a dedicated platform
supported high-resolution relation annotation, persistent node identities,
and multiple predicates per ordered pair. A second review checked endpoint
validity, duplicate triplets, and mask–relation alignment.

支持高分辨率关系注释、持续节点身份,
和每对命令的多个上游。 第二次审查检查了终点
有效性,重复的三胞胎,和面具-关系对齐.

SGPS is evaluated on all 340 panoramas using
panoptic quality (PQ) [ 2 ] , spherical-area-weighted
mean intersection over union (Sphere-mIoU), seam-region mIoU (Seam-mIoU),
instance recall at an IoU threshold of 0.5 (IR@0.5), and mean instance recall
(mIR@0.5). Sphere-mIoU accumulates an a y a_{y} -weighted confusion matrix over
the dataset and averages class IoU over ground-truth-present classes.
Seam-mIoU is computed within the two 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} strips adjacent to the ERP
seam. IR@0.5 uses one-to-one, same-category matching and excludes crowd thing
instances. IR is micro-averaged over eligible instances, whereas mIR is
macro-averaged over ground-truth-present thing categories.

blocks.en:
Relation models use an image-disjoint split of 272 training and 68 validation
panoramas, a 30-epoch training budget, and best-validation checkpoint
selection. Predicate classification (PredCls) uses ground-truth masks and
object labels, isolating relation reasoning from segmentation errors. Although
the annotations permit multiple predicates for each ordered pair,
graph-constrained evaluation retains only
the highest-scoring predicate [ 11 , 7 ] . Recall
at K K (R@ K K ) measures the recovery of ground-truth triplets among the
top- K K predictions per image. Mean recall (mR@ K K ) macro-averages
predicate-specific recall over the 21 predicates, providing a
predicate-balanced complement to aggregate retrieval [ 6 , 7 ] . We report K ∈ { 20 , 50 } K\in\{20,50\} over 1,325 validation relations. Under scene graph detection
(SGDet), node matching requires identical object labels and original-resolution
mask IoU > 0.5 >0.5 . Unmatched predictions remain in the top- K K ranking.
Together, PredCls and SGDet distinguish relation-reasoning gains from
improvements inherited from panoramic node construction while retaining the
same recall-based evaluation.

Our method leads all five metrics in Table 2 . Compared

Our method achieves the highest R@50 of 70.57%, mR@20 of 35.18%, and
mR@50 of 59.48%. Relative to DSFormer, mR@20 and mR@50 increase by 9.68

the relation pathway improves both aggregate and predicate-balanced relation

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a two-stage spherical geometry-aware panoramic PSGG framework
combining SGPS and SGRR, and introduced PanoPSG with 340 panoramas, 10,571
nodes, and 6,632 directed relations. Against corresponding baselines, SGPS
improves PQ by 36.03% under matched views, SGRR improves mR@50 by 11.20%
under PredCls, and the full framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% under SGDet.
SGPS improves graph-node consistency, while SGRR reduces sensitivity to
latitude-dependent area and seam placement. These complementary gains
validate spherical geometry for panoramic PSGG. The framework provides a
unified basis for geometry-consistent scene graphs from high-resolution
panoramas.

将SGPS和SGRR合并,并采用PanoPSG,全景340,10,571
节点,还有6,632个定向关系. 对照相应的基线,全球采购方案
在相应视图下,PQ改进了36.03%,SGRR改进了mR@50,提高了11.20%

SGPS 提高了图形节点的一致性,而SGRR 降低了对

验证全景PSGG的球形几何. 该框架规定:
